configurePresets.name: rv32-nommu
configurePresets.description: QEMU virt machine, 32-bit RISC-V, no MMU (LugalOS's default target).

configurePresets.name: rv32-fold
configurePresets.description: rv32-nommu with its driver endpoints folded (LUGALOS_FOLD): the uart, blk and i2c drivers run in their callers' context, with no task. The folded twin tests/runner.py runs the core suite on (doc/history/adr/008_folded_endpoints.md).

configurePresets.name: rv64-mmu
configurePresets.description: QEMU virt machine, 64-bit RISC-V, Sv39 MMU, S-mode.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-chess
configurePresets.description: Raspberry Pi Pico 2, default board persona: SD card via SPI1, ST7735 TFT + TM1638 keypad + chess engine all built in.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-clock
configurePresets.description: Waveshare Pico-Clock-Green baseboard. GP10-13 drive the SM16106 LED matrix instead of the SD card, so SPI1/SD, the ST7735 TFT and the TM1638 keypad are all built out.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-gateway
configurePresets.description: Bare Pico 2 with an SD card on SPI1 and SPI0 for ENC28J60 Ethernet. Headless file server over USB 9P plus a UART1 downlink.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-wifi
configurePresets.description: Bare Pico 2 W with an SD card on SPI1, CYW43439 Wi-Fi on GP23/24/25/29.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-sensor
configurePresets.description: Bare Pico 2 W with a BME280 on I2C0 (GP4/GP5). Joins Wi-Fi, samples environmental data, and publishes to an MQTT broker. Filesystem is /flash0 alone.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-terminal
configurePresets.description: Waveshare RP2350-LCD-7: RP2350B with 7-inch 800x480 RGB panel, 16 MB flash, microSD socket, PIO-USB host keyboard port, PSRAM, Lisp and chess.

configurePresets.name: esp32p4
configurePresets.description: Waveshare ESP32-P4-NANO (rev v1.3): dual-core RISC-V @ 360-400 MHz, XIP flash, 32 MB PSRAM, RMII Ethernet (100 Mbit/s), SD/MMC microSD socket (/sd0), I2C, chibicc and chess.

configurePresets.name: esp32p4-lcd7b
configurePresets.description: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-7B (rev v3.2): 7" 1024x600 MIPI-DSI panel, GT911 touch, USB 2.0 host, microSD socket, 32 MB PSRAM, ESP32-C6 on SDIO.

configurePresets.name: esp32p4-tab5
configurePresets.displayName: ESP32-P4 (M5Stack Tab5) — tablet & dual-orientation reader persona
configurePresets.description: M5Stack Tab5 (rev v1.3): 5" 720x1280 MIPI-DSI IPS panel (ST7123/ST7121/ILI9881C), capacitive touch, USB 2.0 Type-A host, microSD socket, 32 MB PSRAM, dual PI4IOE5V6408 IO expanders.

configurePresets.name: rv64-smp
configurePresets.displayName: QEMU RV64 (Sv39 MMU) - SMP, two harts
configurePresets.description: QEMU virt machine, 64-bit RISC-V, Sv39 MMU, dual-core SMP with CONFIG_ENABLE_SMP.

configurePresets.name: rp2350-smp
configurePresets.description: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 dual-core SMP build with SIO-FIFO launch for core 1.

configurePresets.name: esp32c6
configurePresets.description: Waveshare ESP32-C6-Zero: RV32IMAC @ 160 MHz, 512 KB SRAM, 8 MB flash, native USB-Serial/JTAG console.

configurePresets.name: esp32c6-release
configurePresets.description: The C6-Zero as a deployed sensor node: no self-tests or demo commands (LUGALOS_DEV=OFF), and the i2c endpoint folded into its callers (LUGALOS_FOLD). The esp32c6 preset is its unfolded dev twin.

configurePresets.name: esp32c6-mini
configurePresets.displayName: ESP32-C6-MINI-1 (beside the P4 on the ESP32-P4-NANO / LCD-7B)
configurePresets.description: ESP32-C6-MINI-1 module on ESP32-P4: 4 MB flash, USB console on header P2, SDIO slave to P4.
